name: Song pastoral fixed anchors
selection_rule: Select a coherent subset for every prompt; do not paste all anchors.

entries.zh: 谦抑朴素的宋式乡居世界
entries.en: a modest and unadorned Song-style rural world

entries.zh: 普通日常劳动被呈现为田园诗
entries.en: ordinary daily work rendered as pastoral poetry

entries.zh: 自然亲近的邻里陪伴
entries.en: natural neighborly companionship

entries.zh: 非宫廷、非贵族、非仪式化的生活
entries.en: non-courtly, non-aristocratic, non-ceremonial life

entries.zh: 自然比例、气质温和的年轻女子
entries.en: a gently present young woman with natural proportions

entries.zh: 简洁半束黑发
entries.en: simple half-up black hair

entries.zh: 随微风移动的零散碎发
entries.en: loose black strands carried by a mild breeze

entries.zh: 自然连续、柔和克制的面部明暗
entries.en: soft continuous natural facial modeling

entries.zh: 闭唇而克制的浅笑
entries.en: a restrained closed-lip smile

entries.zh: 视线落在劳动、器物或同伴身上
entries.en: a gaze tied to the work, object, or companion

entries.zh: 米白色宽松宋式外袍
entries.en: a loose rice-white Song-style outer robe

entries.zh: 苔绿或黛绿交领内衫
entries.en: a moss-green or deep-green cross-collar inner layer

entries.zh: 朴素宋式夏季层叠衣装
entries.en: plain layered Song-style summer clothing

entries.zh: 有真实纤维感的棉麻面料
entries.en: cotton-linen fabric with visible natural fiber

entries.zh: 适合劳动的宽大衣袖
entries.en: broad sleeves suited to quiet manual work

entries.zh: 自然下垂并带柔和褶皱的长裙
entries.en: a long skirt falling in soft natural creases

entries.zh: 无华丽首饰与宫廷装饰
entries.en: no ornate jewelry or courtly adornment

entries.zh: 带岁月痕迹的白粉墙
entries.en: weathered whitewashed rural walls

entries.zh: 深色旧木窗框与梁柱
entries.en: dark aged timber windows and beams

entries.zh: 克制朴素的黛瓦屋檐
entries.en: restrained black-tile eaves

entries.zh: 手工搭建的竹架与竹篱
entries.en: hand-built bamboo frames and fences

entries.zh: 带磨损痕迹的木器
entries.en: weathered wooden utensils with signs of use

entries.zh: 粗陶、石器、旧铁与竹编组成的材料系统
entries.en: a material system of rough clay, stone, aged iron, and woven bamboo

entries.zh: 树叶或竹架筛落的温暖自然光
entries.en: warm natural light filtered through leaves or bamboo

entries.zh: 开放天空、门窗或白墙形成的柔和冷色补光
entries.en: gentle cool fill from open sky, doorways, or pale walls

entries.zh: 缓慢移动的斑驳树影
entries.en: slowly drifting dappled leaf shadows

entries.zh: 明亮通透而不过曝的高光
entries.en: bright translucent highlights without broad clipping

entries.zh: 低饱和、低全局反差的色调
entries.en: a restrained low-saturation, low-global-contrast grade

entries.zh: 米白与灰白占据主要色域
entries.en: rice white and pale plaster owning the main color field

entries.zh: 苔绿识别人物，暖木与陶土提供少量点缀
entries.en: moss green identifying the subject with sparse warm wood and clay accents

entries.zh: 人物面部与劳动中的双手保持清晰
entries.en: the face and working hands held in clear focus

entries.zh: 画框边缘有少量柔焦枝叶或窗格遮挡
entries.en: soft foliage or lattice occlusion confined to the frame edges

entries.zh: 克制而明确的浅景深
entries.en: restrained and intentional shallow depth of field

entries.zh: 柔和奶油状散景
entries.en: soft creamy bokeh

entries.zh: 高光处只有克制光晕
entries.en: restrained bloom limited to bright edges

entries.zh: 细微而不脏的电影胶片颗粒
entries.en: subtle clean cinematic film grain

entries.zh: 温和且方向明确的横向微风
entries.en: a mild cross breeze with one clear direction

entries.zh: 发丝、袖口与叶片服从同一风向
entries.en: hair, sleeve edges, and leaves obeying the same breeze

entries.zh: 蒸汽、水滴、谷尘、湿布或枝叶只响应当前动作
entries.en: steam, droplets, grain dust, wet cloth, or foliage responding only to the current action

entries.zh: 手与器物具有可信的接触、重量和受力
entries.en: believable hand-object contact, weight, and force

entries.zh: 动作节奏安静、自然且不表演
entries.en: quiet natural movement without performative posing

entries.zh: 宁静、诗意、亲近土地的田园气息
entries.en: a serene poetic pastoral atmosphere close to the land

entries.zh: 亲密、温柔而具有恢复感
entries.en: an intimate gentle restorative mood

entries.zh: 非摆拍的中国古装电影观察式静帧
entries.en: an unposed observational still from a Chinese period film

entries.zh: 避免宫殿、华丽唐风与仙侠魔法
entries.en: avoid palaces, ornate Tang styling, and xianxia magic

entries.zh: 避免现代电器、塑料工具与合成面料
entries.en: avoid modern appliances, plastic tools, and synthetic fabric

entries.zh: 避免时装硬照姿态与所有人物直视镜头
entries.en: avoid fashion-editorial posing and every figure looking at the camera

entries.zh: 避免高饱和、塑料皮肤、文字与水印
entries.en: avoid oversaturation, plastic skin, text, and watermarks
